critical_code_review_comments: PDF viewing fix correctly uses direct URL with token auth instead of blob fetch - prevents 'failed to load pdf' errors
Working Paper owner permissions correctly check isOwner (currentFolder.owner_id === user.user_id) in addition to isAdmin
Staff directory endpoint correctly available to all authenticated users (not restricted to admin roles)
Backend DELETE /api/wp/documents/{doc_id} correctly allows folder owners to delete documents
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_OwnerPerms folder during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 tested PDF viewing fix and Working Paper owner permissions. Both features working correctly. PDF viewer now uses direct URL with token auth (BACKEND/api/files/{id}/preview?token=JWT) in an iframe instead of blob fetch. Working Paper folder owners (not just admins) can see Permissions, Delete, Upload, Subfolder buttons on their folders regardless of classification (public/restricted/confidential). Staff directory endpoint GET /api/wp/staff-directory is available to all authenticated users.

pdf_viewing.issue: PDF/document viewer failed to load ('failed to load pdf')
pdf_viewing.fix: Replaced blob-based approach with direct URL+token iframe viewer
pdf_viewing.verification: Iframe src uses /api/files/{id}/preview?token= format, Open in New Tab and Download links present

working_paper_owner_permissions.issue: Folder creators couldn't see Permissions/Delete buttons on restricted/confidential folders
working_paper_owner_permissions.fix: Added isOwner check (currentFolder.owner_id === user.user_id) to UI element visibility
working_paper_owner_permissions.verification: Teacher created restricted folder and saw all owner buttons (Permissions, Delete, Upload, Subfolder, Entry)
